# Cliner

> Cliner is a native, lightweight macOS application uninstaller built with Rust and GPUI. When you drag an application to the macOS Trash, gigabytes of hidden caches, preference plists, application support files, containers, and logs remain scattered across ~/Library. Cliner detects app deletions in real time and completely purges all leftover files in one click. Only $3 one-time, lifetime license, no subscriptions.

## Essential Context

- **Product Name**: Cliner (Cliner for Mac)
- **Tagline**: Uninstall Mac apps completely. Not halfway.
- **Official Website**: https://cliner.app
- **Canonical LLMs.txt**: https://cliner.app/llms.txt
- **Full LLM Context**: https://cliner.app/llms-full.txt
- **Well-Known**: https://cliner.app/.well-known/llms.txt
- **Target OS**: macOS 13.0 (Ventura), macOS 14.0 (Sonoma), macOS 15.0 (Sequoia) or later
- **Architecture**: Universal binary for Apple Silicon (M1/M2/M3/M4) and Intel x86_64
- **Tech Stack**: 100% Native Rust & GPUI (sub-10MB bundle, sub-150ms instant filesystem scan, <25MB RAM)
- **Pricing**: $3.00 USD one-time purchase. Lifetime access on all personal Macs. No subscriptions or renewals. Regular price $5 (40% launch discount).
- **Payment & License Delivery**: Dodo Payments (https://dodo.pe/cliner) — instant license key and direct download via email
- **Safety Model**: 100% reversible via native macOS Trash (Put Back supported, no rm -rf)
- **Refund**: 30-day money-back guarantee
- **Support**: hello@cliner.app
- **X / Twitter**: @clinerapp (https://twitter.com/clinerapp)
- **Last Updated**: 2026-01-15

## Key Features

- **1-Click Deep Cleanup**: Discovers and wipes Application Support, Caches, Preferences, Saved Application State, WebKit data, CrashReporter logs, and Sandbox Containers across 10+ macOS locations.
- **Automatic Trash Watcher**: Silently detects when an application is dragged to Trash via FSEvents/kqueue and offers 1-click leftover purging.
- **Smart Update Detection**: Distinguishes app updates and reinstallations from genuine uninstalls so it never interrupts normal workflow (zero false positives).
- **Privacy & Offline First**: 100% local processing. No user analytics, no background telemetry, no cloud dependencies. Offline capable.
- **Blazing Fast**: <150ms scan, ~8MB memory, 400×600 tiny window, native GPU-accelerated UI.

## Pricing & Comparison

- **Cliner**: $3 one-time (lifetime) — Native Rust + GPUI, <10MB, <25MB RAM, <150ms scan, Trash-reversible, zero daemons.
- **CleanMyMac X**: $39.95/year — ~120MB, 300-600MB RAM, 5-15s scan, heavy background services, telemetry/upsells.
- **AppCleaner**: Free — Legacy Objective-C, optional Trash watcher, slower.
- **Pearcleaner**: Free — Swift, ~40MB, ~500ms, no subscription.

See full comparison: https://cliner.app/#compare and https://cliner.app/llms-full.txt

## FAQ Summary

- **Why need Cliner if macOS has Trash?** Trash only deletes .app bundle; ~/Library leftovers (often GBs) remain. Cliner finds and removes them with one click.
- **Is $3 a subscription?** No, one-time forever, all future updates included.
- **Checkout & delivery?** Dodo Payments, instant email with download + license key.
- **Safe if mistake?** 100% reversible via macOS Trash Put Back.
- **Bothers during updates?** No, distinguishes updates vs uninstalls.
- **Which Macs?** macOS 13 Ventura, 14 Sonoma, 15 Sequoia — Apple Silicon M1/M2/M3/M4 and Intel.

Full FAQ: https://cliner.app/#faq
